label: Contained in a bearer: generic, intentional (apprehended) and virtual (not apprehended)
resolution: CONTAINED_IN_1 (generic) is the sense of the locus bridges 65805e5a-818a-49a0-ae3c-eba95724500f and 69b9f887-582a-479c-924b-e7328f3930b4 and of the antecedent of the containment-recognition bridge d1fb6414-976e-4833-908d-17787cca2502; CONTAINED_IN_2 (intentional) is that bridge's consequent; CONTAINED_IN_3 (virtual) is the rival's reading of its contained stand-ins. Generic containment is entailed by each of the others; intentional and virtual containment exclude each other by their Lean bodies (one requires apprehension, the other its absence). The registered derivation of the cognition criterion 3b40009e-1c56-4cce-86ba-1980fd2cb9a7 passes from CONTAINED_IN_1 to CONTAINED_IN_2 only through d1fb6414, declared as its sense bridge; no step passes from virtual to intentional containment, which is exactly what the rival denies.
